title: Edit menu and logo inside the website editor opens the menu editor, not an empty dialog

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), website cluster review of #3372 (LIVE-891).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the website editor runs on the site's own host (/admin/editor) and mounts SiteMenuEditor, whose getSiteMenuEditorData, saveSiteMenu, saveHeaderLogo and uploadSpaceImage authorize through getCallerProfile, the Frequency session cookie. That cookie is host-only (no domain option in lib/supabase/server.ts) and never reaches <slug>.frequencylocal.com or a custom domain, which is why the site-admin pass exists. authorize() returns null and the dialog renders nothing; save and logo upload would fail too. LIVE-891 is closed with a probe that only checks the mount. THE FIX: pass-authorized twins (loadWebsiteMenu, saveWebsiteMenu, saveWebsiteHeaderLogo gated by authorizeWebsiteEditor(host)) and an actions prop on SiteMenuEditor. A link to /spaces/<slug>/manage/layout would be a stopgap but would fail LIVE-891's probe, so it needs the owner's word.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('lib/sites/editor').some(f=>/authorizeWebsiteEditor/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/'+f))&&/saveWebsiteMenu/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-832: the menu editor mounted on the website host has no host-authorized actions');process.exit(1)}"
